title: Goofy Ahh Car Horn
blurb: This horn has no business sounding the way it does. An ordinary car horn communicates warning; this one communicates circus, and applying it to any arrival or departure reclassifies the driver as a clown without a word being said. Play it when somebody turns up forty minutes late holding an iced coffee they stopped for, or when a person leaves the group chat immediately after starting an argument in it. Beep beep, but disrespectfully, and with the full weight of the goofy ahh tradition behind it.
origin: From the goofy ahh meme genre, vehicle horns included.
